name: @w6w-apps/jinaai
description: Generate embeddings, rerank and classify text with Jina AI's Search Foundation API.

w6w.longDescription:
Jina AI's Search Foundation API is the embedding/reranking/classification backbone behind a lot of retrieval-augmented and search-driven LLM applications: dense text and multimodal embeddings (`jina-embeddings-v3`/`v4`/`v5`, CLIP, ColBERT multi-vector, code-specialized models), a cross-encoder reranker for refining search results, zero-shot and few-shot text/image classification against trainable classifiers, an experimental vision-language chat completion endpoint, and an asynchronous batch embeddings pipeline for bulk JSONL jobs too large for a single request.

This app covers the full `api.jina.ai` Search Foundation surface documented in Jina's own OpenAPI 3.1 specification — embeddings, reranking, classification, classifier training/management, model discovery, batch embedding jobs, and the (vendor-labelled experimental) chat completions endpoint. It deliberately does NOT cover Jina's separate Reader (`r.jina.ai`), Search (`s.jina.ai`) or DeepSearch products, which are different hosts with their own, undocumented-here, API shapes.

Health checks track Jina's own Statuspage (scoped to the Embedding Models and Reranker Models components this app actually calls) plus a lightweight, no-token-cost credential probe.
